propertySets.name: Pset_TubeBundleTypeFinned
propertySets.definition:
Finned tube bundle type attributes.
Contains the attributes related to the fins attached to a tube in a finned tube bundle such as is commonly found in coils.

properties.name: Spacing
properties.definition: Distance between fins on a tube in the tube bundle.

properties.name: Thickness
properties.definition: The geometric thickness of the object.

properties.name: ThermalConductivity
properties.definition: The thermal conductivity of the object.

properties.name: Length
properties.definition:
The length of the object.

As measured parallel to the direction of airflow.

properties.name: Height
properties.definition:
Characteristic height

Length of the fin as measured perpendicular to the direction of airflow.

properties.name: Diameter
properties.definition:
The Diameter of the object.

For circular fins only.

properties.name: FinCorrugatedType
properties.definition: Description of a fin corrugated type.

properties.name: HasCoating
properties.definition: TRUE if the fin has a coating, FALSE if it does not.
